answer.thought: The body is a machine out of order, but the mind must keep its own clock. I will sit with the Philosophy of Right, not to find answers, but to see if the text still holds its shape when the world it describes is so utterly absent. The universal must be actual, but here, it seems, it is merely potential, or perhaps merely a ghost.
